_readme: Evidence for the ElevenLabs model line.
Audio is INVENTORY AND INTELLIGENCE in this phase. Nothing generates sound: CineBraid
has no audio dispatch path, no casting concept and no way to attach a generated line
to a shot. What this record buys is the ability to describe audio models in the same
vocabulary as everything else, so that when audio is wired the catalogue is already
there and the vocabulary does not have to be invented under deadline.
The vendor publishes per-model character limits, which is unusually useful: a long
speech can be budgeted before it is sent rather than discovered at truncation.

creative.note: The vendor's own list states v1 is outclassed by v2.

capabilities.claim: eleven_v3 supports 70+ languages with a 5,000-character request limit.
A separate voice-DESIGN model line exists, distinct from voice selection.
capabilities.note: This is what a production needs to cast a character rather than pick a preset.

capabilities.claim: Music and sound-effects generation are separate models in the same line.
Latency figures exclude application and network latency.

notEstablished.claim: Request parameters, output formats and sample rates.
notEstablished.status: the API reference introduction did not carry them and no endpoint reference was read
notEstablished.cineBraidBehaviour: No parameter is encoded. Only the model line, language counts and character limits are.

notEstablished.claim: Music model duration, structure controls or reference audio.
notEstablished.status: not documented in what was read

No pricing is recorded for this family.
